newsitem.title: USA: Jordan buys 100,000 T PL-480 wheat - exporters.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buys 100,000 T PL-480 wheat - exporters.

text.p: Jordan early Friday bought a total of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, U.S. exporters said.
The wheat was divided into two lots, one for delivery in May and the other in June, the exporters said.
"The offers went out yesterday (Thursday) afternoon," one U.S. exporter said.
A second exporter said the May shipment was bought at around $182.00 a tonne, FOB, Beaumont, Texas and the June shipment was purchased at about $179.00 a tonne.
Initially, Jordan was seeking around $21 million of U.S. wheat -- about 120,000 tonnes -- financed under the PL-480 program, grain traders in Jordan said.
